rows.definition: The taskgraph.Table.AttentionNeeded bool field: true when any Task in the folded shared-task table carries a refusal finding, the one-bit gate a supervisor loop or CI keys on without re-scanning every task row.
rows.distinction: It is a SHARED-TASK rollup bit over refusal findings, not the toolproc process-table rollup bit (AttentionNeeded toolproc) and not the ML softmax token-mixer (Attention) despite sharing the 'attention' word.

rows.definition: The toolproc.Table.AttentionNeeded bool field: true when any finding across the kernel's tool-call process table advises more than plain observe, the one-bit gate a supervisor loop or CI keys on for tool-process health.
rows.distinction: It is a TOOL-PROCESS rollup bit over finding severity, a separate Go field from the taskgraph shared-task rollup bit (AttentionNeeded taskgraph) despite the identical field name and doc pattern.

rows.definition: internal/compute's recorded device-vs-cpuref-f32 cosine floor (0.999) for the GLM-MoE-DSA sparse-attention kernel k_dsa_sparse_attend, whose host side already selected the exact keys so the only drift source is f32 reduction order; the value RECORDS the contract threshold an out-of-tree CUDA-node witness checks and does not itself assert a pass.
rows.distinction: It is a CUDA-BACKEND accuracy-gate CONSTANT for one specific kernel (GLM-DSA sparse attend), not the SDPA scale-factor constant (attnScale) and not the host-side DSA key-stride layout constant (glmDsaAttentionKStride).
